value.label: Corrected terminal accounting: the finite-real regret identity
value.plain: An arbitrary state type E, total real-valued functions psi and loss on natural time and E, an arbitrary sequence x, comparator u and terminal z, and a natural horizon T>0. No convexity, norm, optimizer, algorithm, probability or causal premise is required. Finite real arithmetic is a specialization: the full EReal/domain adapter remains separate. Indices are zero-based: source round s corresponds to t=s-1. G includes the current loss through t. Only the unscored coordinate T is spliced to z; all y(t)=x(t) for t<T. The original x(T) is unused. The interior drift has indices0..T-2; forT1 it is empty. T0 is not claimed.
value.fallback: Regret equals the final comparator regularizer minus the initial played regularizer, plus within-potential differences, interior regularizer drift and the terminal cumulative-objective gap.

value.title: Why the terminal gap belongs in the regret identity
value.plain: An arbitrary state type E, total real-valued functions psi and loss on natural time and E, an arbitrary sequence x, comparator u and terminal z, and a natural horizon T>0. No convexity, norm, optimizer, algorithm, probability or causal premise is required. Finite real arithmetic is a specialization: the full EReal/domain adapter remains separate. Indices are zero-based: source round s corresponds to t=s-1. G includes the current loss through t. Only the unscored coordinate T is spliced to z; all y(t)=x(t) for t<T. The original x(T) is unused. The interior drift has indices0..T-2; forT1 it is empty. T0 is not claimed.
value.intuition: The terminal point appears once with a minus sign inside the last within-potential difference and once with a plus sign in the endpoint gap. Their cancellation explains why the scored regret does not depend on an unplayed endpoint.
value.why: One shared algebraic component needed by labeled terminal corrections, not a complete regret theorem or source-container count.
value.position: Finite-real corrected accounting near Theorem7.47 proof, PDF141–142; related Theorem15.31 terminal convention, PDF278–279. The full EReal adapter, actual optimistic-FTRL/BTRL producers, ghost attainment, support qualification, strong-convex stability, Young estimate and whole corrected7.47/15.31 bounds remain open. value.proof_idea: Put H_t(v)=sum_{i<t}loss_i(v), so G_t=psi_t+H_(t+1). The regularizer parts of the within-G sum, together with the interior drift, telescope to psi_0(y_0)-psi_(T-1)(z). The cumulative-loss parts telescope to sum_{t<T}loss_t(y_t)-H_T(z). Adding the final comparator regularizer minus the initial played regularizer and the retained G_(T-1)(z)-G_(T-1)(u) leaves exactly the regret. This is the mathematical cancellation argument, not a claimed implementation route.
value.lean_notes: E has no additional typeclass assumptions; psi/loss are real-valued and T>0 is the only propositional premise. The boundary regularizer difference is psi_(T-1)(u)-psi_0(y_0): final comparator regularizer minus initial played regularizer. Local y and G are definitions, not extra hypotheses. The exact Lean header and full-proof source link use the declaration fold; these notes do not claim a complete rendered source-proof graph. Selected actual compiled direct VALUE occurrences are Nat.recAux, Finset.sum_range_succ, Finset.sum_range_zero and Nat.sub_add_cancel. Occurrence does not establish logical necessity or a complete transitive graph; Nat.rec is not the exported direct constant. The source-only AND topology remains distinct from these implementation occurrences.
